title: Lab 2 - Exploring pipeline configuration, part 1
description: before_script, artifacts, dependencies and needs on a four-job pipeline.
scenario: The KodeKloud 'Exploring Pipeline Configuration Part-1' lab: wire four jobs together with stages, hand a file forward with artifacts, then let the DAG start jobs early with needs.
environment_setup:
# A gitlab.com account (free tier is enough) with shared runners enabled on the project,
# git on your machine, and a terminal. Keep Build → Pipelines open in a second tab.
git --version
git remote -v
cleanup: # Nothing to clean: pipelines and jobs are history. Delete the scratch project when the track is over.

tasks.title: Task 1 - before_script
tasks.instructions: Give every job a default before_script that prints the job name and the runner hostname, and a job-level one on a single job that replaces it.
tasks.solution:
default:
  before_script: ["echo $CI_JOB_NAME on $(hostname)"]
special:
  before_script: ["echo replaced"]
  script: ["true"]
tasks.verification: The special job's log shows 'replaced' and NOT the default line.

tasks.title: Task 2 - Artifacts
tasks.instructions: compile (stage build) writes out/app; test-binary (stage test) checks it exists. Make it pass, then remove artifacts: and watch it fail.
tasks.solution:
compile:
  stage: build
  script: ["mkdir -p out && echo binary > out/app"]
  artifacts: {paths: [out/], expire_in: 1 hour}
test-binary:
  stage: test
  script: ["test -f out/app"]
tasks.verification: Passes with artifacts; 'No such file' without them.

tasks.title: Task 3 - dependencies
tasks.instructions: Add a third stage job package that should download ONLY compile's artifacts, not test-binary's.
tasks.solution:
package:
  stage: package
  dependencies: [compile]
  script: ["ls out/"]
tasks.verification: Log's 'Downloading artifacts' lines name only compile.

tasks.title: Task 4 - needs
tasks.instructions: Add build-web (sleep 60) in stage build and test-web needing it; give test-binary needs: [compile]. Confirm test-binary starts before build-web finishes.
tasks.verification: In the pipeline's Needs view test-binary completes while build-web is still running.
